On **28 March 2025** I gave a talk in the **IAS-CSIC Seminar Series** at the Institute for Sustainable Agriculture in Córdoba: ***"Integración de teledetección y modelos epidemiológicos para la vigilancia operativa y la evaluación del riesgo de enfermedades en plantas en el contexto del cambio climático"*** (Integrating remote sensing and epidemiological models for the operational surveillance and risk assessment of plant diseases in the context of climate change).

In the seminar I explained how satellite data can be combined with epidemiological and species distribution models to monitor plant diseases and assess their risk under climate change, the research line of my [MOMENTUM project](../projects/momentum.qmd).

The seminar was streamed live and the recording is available on the IAS-CSIC YouTube channel (the talk is in Spanish):

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kO8bjD_b2bg title="IAS-CSIC Seminar – Rocío Calderón" >}}
